Adaptation: Swashbuckler
Instant20 sec cooldown
Requires One-Handed Axes, One-Handed Maces, One-Handed Swords, Bows, Crossbows, Guns
Increases Attack Power by 15%, Parry Chance by 10% and reduces Ranged Attack Power by 50%. Successful parries have a chance to apply Counterstruck.

Using Ravage allows you to use abilities that require you to parry.

Can only be used with a one-handed melee weapon, and no off-hand.

Only 1 Adaptation can be active at a time.
Sane
You cannot go insane again for the duration.
